His disorientation also increases his risk for falls and potential injury.

## Triage Vitals Threshold Rationale

Blood pressure normal range is based on his mean SBP (92 mmHg) and DBP (70 mmHg), with a slightly wider range to account for variability (SBP 90-140, DBP 60-90). Respiratory rate normal range is based on his mean (16 bpm) and range (11-26 bpm), set conservatively (12-20 bpm). Temperature normal range is based on his mean (36.7°C) and range (35.2-36.8°C), adjusted slightly (36.5-37.5°C). SpO2 normal range is set at >95% as per standard guidelines, with a high end of 100% as values up to 100% are acceptable. Warning thresholds are set slightly outside the normal ranges to indicate potential deterioration. Given his age and history, even minor deviations warrant attention.
